description: Valid and invalid 2.2 sources outside the gate-1 corpus for WP8: deployments on platforms shaped like operating-system tasks with their own task definitions and priority attributes (the door model shape), own packages named Swaml::Os that declare Core, Task and TaskKind in the library shape or partially, names Task, Core, TaskKind, kind, priority, preemptive, periodNs and responseNs in ordinary positions, deploy paths that end at operations no entry releases, at members that are no operations or at missing names (2.2: unknown software occurrences), family and indexed paths, duplicate paths, nested platform families, and equal-time releases, deliveries, after successors, requests and waits across placed occurrences. In 2.3 Swaml::Os is a library package, an operation placement path to a released operation is valid and Tasks of Swaml::Os order equal-time work (WP8-S01, WP8-L01, WP8-R01); none of these sources uses the library package or places a released operation, so their diagnostics, ASTs and runs must stay as recorded. Each parses with the kept 2.2 grammar. Their diagnostics (with related information), normalized ASTs and runs are recorded once from implementation 3.1.0 in recorded-wp8.json and compared by scripts/compatibility-2-2-extended.mjs.

models.name: w1 a door-like platform with its own OsTask and priorities: equal-time releases on many tasks keep the 2.2 order (runs)

w2 an own package Swaml::Os with Core, Task and TaskKind in the library shape: duplicate priorities, non-multiple periods, event entries on periodic tasks and suspension on basic tasks are not task rules in 2.2 (runs)
w3 an own Swaml::Os package with a partial library shape, used through qualified names; a component placed on two Cores
w4 components, an enum and attributes named Task, Core, TaskKind, kind, priority, preemptive, periodNs and responseNs in a package without Swaml::Os (runs)
w5 an operation placement path that names an operation no entry releases: unknown software occurrence
w6 operation-like paths to members that are no operations: an attribute, a port, a nested operation, a missing name and an index after an operation
w7 family and indexed operation-like paths to unreleased operations, and duplicate exact paths
w8 a multiplicity platform with nested families, family and indexed placements and an unplaced occurrence (runs)
w9 a test of a deployed subject with equal-time work on several placed occurrences, receive entries, after successors and waits (cases)
w10 one top-level occurrence deployed twice and a platform root that is no Node, beside names like core, task and isr
w11 a component on a Node with the door model shape and a background process, with requests and waits on low-priority work (runs)
w12 an own Swaml::Os package that only declares an enum and a component def named Os, and an import of it next to Swaml::Platform
w13 deploy statements whose targets start with a root-relative operation name and an empty root placement on a nested node (runs)
w14 equal-time every, start, after and receive releases across occurrences with priorities in own attributes (runs)
